svg.desc: 2025 – now: feat(ai) Agent harnesses, MCP servers, skills and AI governance. Claude Code agents with a focus on security and confidentiality. Corporate AI trainings so whole teams can work this way. Claude Code, Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, LangChain, MCP, Hugging Face. Jun 2026 – now: feat(payments) Avianca payments core integrated with DEUNA and Wompi. Senior Red Hat integration engineer. Integration architecture on Quarkus and Apache Camel connecting the core with each Latam payment provider. Dec 2025 – Jun 2026: feat(gov) Three mission systems for the Fiscalía General de la Nación. Full stack tech lead: extradition and capture, victim and witness protection, private prosecutors. NestJS, React and Oracle PL/SQL on OpenShift with GitHub Actions. Oct 2025 – Jan 2026: refactor(bus) IBM App Connect to Quarkus, Camel and Kafka on Kubernetes. Led the integration bus migration for CELSIA's electricity metering systems, with end-to-end observability on Grafana, Loki and Tempo. Mar 2024 – now: feat(mobility) Payments and mobility platform for Flypass tolls and parking. Technical lead at Quind. Microservices and data streaming with Spring Boot, Kafka and CQRS on AWS; legacy moved to Quarkus, GraalVM, Java 21 and virtual threads; ADRs, code review, SonarQube. 2024: perf(devex) -40% time-to-market with a developer experience platform. Backstage, AWS Service Catalog and project archetypes, presented to the C-level. Jul 2023 – Mar 2024: feat(transport) IP/REV electronic toll interoperability and RUNT services. Ministry of Transport: interoperability between toll operators and TAG providers nationwide. Java, Node.js, WebFlux, Quarkus, Kafka, Angular and React on AWS. 2022: perf(banking) -98% latency: 5 s to 100 ms at 10,000 req/s. Critical microservices for Banco de la República with WebFlux, Redis and MongoDB; ACID fixes raised data consistency by 90%. Feb 2021 – Jul 2023: chore(lead) Technical lead of two teams of four developers. INDRA Colombia. Java 8 to 17 microservices with Spring Cloud, GCP Pub/Sub, Apigee, AWS and DynamoDB; ran a Coding Dojo. Jul 2020 – now: feat(cargo) RNDC integration for Grupo Nutresa and Rápido Ochoa. Remesas, electronic cargo manifests and cumplidos with validation and traceability; event-driven dispatch lifecycle and freight reconciliation. 2020 – now: refactor(legacy) Strangler Fig and CDC with Debezium and Confluent. Oracle and Java legacy modernization, LDAP to Keycloak and OAuth2, Kafka cluster tuning and disaster recovery with MirrorMaker 2. 2020 – 2021: feat(data) ETL and ELT for telecom big data at Emtelco Tigo-Une. Java, C# and PL/SQL pipelines. 2017: init From IT support to software. Atento help desk, Odoo ERP and POS at iKono, database tuning at Estatal de Seguridad. Systems technology degree, 2018 – 2021.
